title.zh: 海滩宾客用品租赁助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Issue and reconcile shore-based guest equipment using numbered records.
requirements.zh: 使用编号记录发放并核对岸上宾客用品。

requirements.en: Identify visible damage and communicate supervisor-approved hire restrictions.
requirements.zh: 识别可见损坏，并传达主管批准的租赁限制。

requirements.en: Record receipts and refer deposit-refund decisions to the responsible supervisor.
requirements.zh: 记录收款，并将押金退款决定转交负责主管。

requirements.en: Be available for the entire 2027-05 to 2027-09 season.
